Note:  
1. SC, ST, PwD students are exempted from paying the tuition fees. 
However, there is no exemption in Tuition fee for the self-
sponsored/project  sponsored  /Sponsored  /External  /executive 
/Working- professionals / Part-time (online) students. 
2. For the B.Tech.-M.Tech./MBA dual degree students, the B.Tech. fees (Tuition 
& semester fee) will be charged upto 8th semester and M.Tech./MBA fees 
(Tuition & semester fee) would be charged from 9th semester onward. 
3. The students of the MBA and MBA in FinTech & Cybersecurity program 
opting for dual degree in second year require to pay day scholars fees at 
the Institute and other applicable fees to the Partner Institute. 
4. Part-time/Part-time online/External students are required to pay the 
semester fee as per day-scholar category. In case the student wants to 
avail the hostel facility, he/she shall pay the difference of hosteller and 
day scholar fee. 
5. All the students (except Part-time/Part-time online/external) are required 
to register as hosteller during the admission. 
6. Candidates wishing to cancel/withdraw admission after paying the 
requisite fees, the fees will be refunded after deducting processing fees of 
Rs. 5000/- from the total fees, only if such request is received by date

7. Collection of the convocation fee from final year and other already 
registered students (who have not paid yet): The mandatory convocation 
fee would be collected at the time of registration for the convocation 
ceremony. 
8. Collection of the convocation fee from new students: The mandatory 
one-time convocation fees would be charged at the time of admission 
from the new students for AY 2026-27 semester -I. 
9. Convocation fee includes the degree certificate, award ceremony charges 
and one convocation dinner/lunch for students graduating. 
10.  Convocation fee is indicative and subject to revision as per Institute-
approved rates prevailing at the time of convocation. 
11.  The total amount is determined based on the fee structure prevailing as 
on the date of issue of the offer letter. The same shall be subject to 
revision, if any, as may be approved by the institute from time to time in 
accordance with applicable policies, rules and regulations.
